title: Quantitative propagation of chaos for particle systems with memory and their long-time behaviour
summary: We study a class of interacting diffusion particle systems with memory and their mean-field limit using coupling methods. We first establish quantitative propagation of chaos estimates for this class of models. Our first main result is a uniform-in-time propagation of chaos estimate, under a suitable contraction condition. We also discuss conditions for existence of stationary solutions and show that long-time convergence to a non-stationary measure may also hold.
